chapter: Early career: vaudeville and Kansas City
title: Feather's Encyclopedia entry and Basie saving details for his book
summary: Kuehl reads the Encyclopedia of Jazz biography; Basie says he cannot go into early Harlem and how he got there because he is writing his own book.
